scripts.local: bun run local:infra && dotenv -e .env.local -- turbo run local
scripts.local:infra: ENV_FILE=.env.local docker-compose --env-file .env.local --project-name runtipi -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d ci-os-hub-queue ci-hub-db
scripts.local:cleanup: bun run cleanup && rm -rf .internal && rm -rf tunnel/token tunnel/certs
scripts.start:prod: bun scripts/init-traefik.ts && ENV_FILE=.env.prod CI_CLOUD_API_URL=https://ci.computer/api docker-compose --env-file .env.prod --project-name runtipi -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build
scripts.start:staging: bun scripts/init-traefik.ts && ENV_FILE=.env.staging CI_CLOUD_API_URL=https://companionintel.com/api docker-compose --env-file .env.staging --project-name runtipi -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build
scripts.start:dev: bun scripts/init-traefik.ts && ENV_FILE=.env.dev CI_CLOUD_API_URL=https://setup.companionintelligence.com/api docker-compose --env-file .env.dev --project-name runtipi -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build
scripts.check:all: bun run lint && turbo run tsc && turbo run build && turbo run test
